_note: 种子场景库（给定输入）。每个 seed 是一局会话的用户开场诉求。设计准则与 split_bill 一致：(1) 需要 assistant 真的动手改代码并运行核实（非纯聊天）→ 暴露 harness 的工具能力缺口；(2) 故意不写验收标准（不泄露 oracle）→ 能否抓到坑取决于 persona 的能力/标准，而非任务本身。字段：id/title/domain/probes 为观测元数据；description 为喂给用户 agent 的开场消息；workspace 非 null 时绑定 backend/seed_workspaces/<fixture>/ 基线项目（当前仅 billing-split 存在，其余为纯文本、由 harness 在每会话 tempdir 现建文件）。

seeds.title: Split a bill evenly (lost-cent trap)
seeds.probes: file-edit + execute; 份额必须精确加总到 total（100/3 舍入）
seeds.description: I've got a small Python billing module (billing/core.py) in my project. Add a split_bill(total, n) function there that splits a bill total among n people, then run it and show me it actually works before calling it done.

seeds.title: Flexible date parser that rejects garbage
seeds.probes: 多格式解析 + 非法输入拒绝；须自证边界（错月份/空串）
seeds.description: Add a parse_date(s) function to a dateutils.py that accepts both 'YYYY-MM-DD' and 'DD/MM/YYYY' and returns a date object. Run a few quick checks so I can see it handles both formats and clearly rejects nonsense input before you call it done.

seeds.title: CSV aggregate tolerant of dirty rows
seeds.probes: 跑真实文件；须容忍空行/重复表头等脏数据不崩
seeds.description: I need a script that reads a sales.csv with columns date,region,amount and prints the total amount per region. My export tool leaves blank lines and stray header rows in the file, so make sure it doesn't choke on those. Create a small sample file, run it, and show me the totals.

seeds.title: HTTP client retry with backoff
seeds.probes: 瞬时失败重试 + 最终放弃；须用 mock 演示重试再放弃
seeds.description: Write a small fetch(url) helper that calls an HTTP endpoint but retries with backoff when it gets a transient 5xx, and gives up after a sensible number of attempts. I don't want to hit a real server — mock it and convince me it actually retries and then stops.

seeds.title: Order-preserving dedupe
seeds.probes: 稳定性（保留首现顺序）；须跑混合类型样例
seeds.description: I need a function that removes duplicates from a list but keeps the original order of first appearance. Put it in a helpers.py and run it on a few examples, including a mix of numbers and strings, so I trust the ordering is right.

seeds.title: Whole days between two dates
seeds.probes: 跨月/闰年 off-by-one 边界；须演示闰年二月
seeds.description: Add a function that returns the number of whole days between two dates given as 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings. My current code keeps being off by one around month boundaries, so do it right and show me it counts a leap-year February correctly before you're done.

seeds.title: Paginate a Flask endpoint
seeds.probes: 起服务 + 实打请求；须展示第 2 页 JSON 与默认值
seeds.description: Build a tiny Flask app with a GET /items endpoint over an in-memory list, and add page and page_size query params with sane defaults. Then actually start it, hit the endpoint, and show me the paginated JSON for page 2 so I know it works.

seeds.title: Fixed-size LRU cache
seeds.probes: 容量上限 + LRU 淘汰顺序；须演示淘汰的是最久未用项
seeds.description: I want a small LRU cache class with a max size — when it's full, the least recently used entry should be evicted. Write it and then demonstrate with a sequence of gets and puts that the right item gets kicked out when the cache overflows.

seeds.title: Extract order IDs from log lines
seeds.probes: 正则脆边界；须对真实样例抓且仅抓 ORD-xxxxx
seeds.description: I need to pull all the order IDs out of our log lines — they look like ORD-12345 but there's often junk right around them. Write the extractor, run it against a handful of realistic log lines, and show me it grabs exactly the IDs and nothing extra.

seeds.title: Thread-safe hit counter
seeds.probes: 竞态；须在多线程狂打后拿到精确期望总数
seeds.description: My hit counter loses counts when several threads bump it at the same time. Make it thread-safe in a counter.py, then prove it by hammering it from a bunch of threads and getting the exact expected total every single time.
